content:
Apple TV subscribers can now watch the first two episodes of 'Last Seen', an Australian kidnapping thriller starring Patrick Brammall from 'Glitch'. Watch the trailer below.

The first two episodes of 'Last Seen' are now available to stream on Apple TV.

Less than a month after Apple TV first announced 'Last Seen', the platform has launched the first two episodes of this brand-new six-part thriller.

Adapted from award-winning author Ryan David Jahn's novel 'The Dispatcher', new episodes will be released every Wednesday until 7 October.

'Last Seen' kicks off Apple TV's autumn slate, followed by the likes of 'Slow Horses' Season 6, 'Brothers' starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson, the animated film 'Matchbox: The Movie' premiere, and the second season of 'Where's Wanda?'.

The platform also recently premiered 'Mayday' starring Ryan Reynolds ('Deadpool') and Kenneth Branagh ('Oppenheimer').
